models: saved fixed-attack local-angle checkpoints from seeds 62--71
eligible_seed_rule: balanced CA at least 0.90 and ASR at least 0.80
measurement_model: independent binomial X/Z expectation estimates for clean and attacked checkpoints
poison_pool: held-out triggered training-source samples not restricted to the 60 samples used to train the victim
reference_contamination_model: replace validation-target reference items with triggered validation-source items while preserving pool size 200
interpretation: retrospective operating-boundary analysis, not a new method-selection dataset
